title: Workshop Overview
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Workshop mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about only Workshop Enhancements, unrelated tracker calculations, or guidance about the best upgrade order.
content: Workshop Overview. The tower has 3 types of upgrades: Attack, Defense and Utility. These upgrades can be bought between rounds with Coins and during rounds with cash. Upgrades bought with coins are permanent while upgrades bought with cash will reset each round. Ultimate Weapons unlocks and upgrades can also be purchased through the workshop menu.

title: Workshop Enhancements Overview
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Workshop Enhancements mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about the unlock gate by itself, individual enhancement rows in isolation, or unrelated Workshop calculator formulas.
content: Workshop Enhancements Overview. Workshop Enhancements also have the same 3 types: Attack, Defense and Utility. New Enhancements of each are unlocked by spending coins on other enhancements of the same type. Workshop Enhancements are split into Attack, Defense, and Utility, and each category unlocks further rows by spending coins on other enhancements of the same type. The page therefore treats Workshop Enhancements as a separate layer from the normal Workshop cash-and-coin upgrades.

title: Unlocking Workshop Enhancements
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Workshop Enhancements unlock mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about general workshop upgrades, unrelated tiers, or a recommendation for which enhancement to prioritize.
content: Unlocking Workshop Enhancements. Workshop Enhancements are unlocked at tier 12 wave 60. Requires the Workshop Enhancement lab to be completed. The unlock question is therefore about meeting the Tier 12 Wave 60 milestone and completing the Workshop Enhancement lab, not about spending coins or stones to buy the feature directly from a separate menu. Once the unlock condition has been satisfied, enhancement-related planning becomes a normal workshop topic. Before that threshold, the correct answer is simply that the account needs the Tier 12 Wave 60 milestone, not a calculator formula or tracker workaround.

title: Attack Workshop Stats Overview
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Attack Workshop Stats mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about attack Workshop Enhancements, unrelated categories, or build recommendations.
content: Attack Workshop Stats Overview. The site Workshop data exposes the following attack stats: Damage, Attack Speed, Critical Chance, Critical Factor, Range, Damage / Meter, Multishot Chance, Multishot Targets, Rapid Fire Chance, Rapid Fire Duration, Bounce Shot Chance, Bounce Shot Targets, Bounce Shot Range, Super Crit Chance, Super Crit Mult, Rend Armor Chance, Rend Armor Mult. Attack Workshop stats are the normal cash-and-coin upgrade rows from workshop.json, not the separate Attack enhancement ladder unlocked later through Workshop Enhancements. Only modules have substats in site data, and those substats are grouped into exactly four module families: Cannon, Armor, Generator, and Core. Core module substats focus on Ultimate Weapon effects rather than normal Workshop rows, so Workshop stat chunks only cite the relevant Cannon, Armor, or Generator entries.

title: Damage Workshop Stat
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Damage Workshop Stat mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about the Damage Enhancement row, unrelated Attack stats, or tracker recommendations.
content: Damage Workshop Stat. Definition. Damage is the base value used to determine how much each tower projectile deals to enemies. It is the foundational stat for tower projectiles, land mines, and Ultimate Weapons that scale from tower damage. Type: Workshop. Category: Attack. Aliases: dmg. Formula. Displayed Damage = Workshop × Lab × Damage Card × (1 + Relics) × (1 + Cannon Module %) × Enhancements × Perk1 + Berserker2 No rounding is applied at any stage. Perk1 = (1 + 0.15 × Quantity) × (1 + Standard Perk Bonus). Berserker adds stored bonus damage up to a +700% cap (8× base). Workshop. Unlocked at the start of the game. Maximum of 6000 levels. Damage can be increased using cards, relics, modules, and Workshop Enhancements.

title: Attack Speed Workshop Stat
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Attack Speed Workshop Stat mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about the Attack Speed Enhancement row, unrelated Attack stats, or tracker recommendations.
content: Attack Speed Workshop Stat. Definition. Attack Speed controls how many projectiles the tower fires and also increases projectile travel speed before Light Speed Shots is unlocked. At low values it is close to shots per second, but the stat becomes less linear at higher values and remains under analysis after the V27 performance changes. Once Light Speed Shots is completed, normal tower projectiles travel instantly to their target and no longer gain travel speed from Attack Speed. Type: Workshop. Category: Attack. Aliases: aspd; as. Formula. Displayed Attack Speed = (Workshop × Lab × Card + Module Sub Effect) × Enhancement No rounding is applied at any stage. Workshop. Unlocked at the start of the game. 99 workshop levels. Base value 1.00; each level adds 0.05 for 5.95 total before other multipliers.

Category: Attack. Aliases: cc. Formula. None. Workshop. Unlocked at the start of the game. 79 workshop levels. Each level adds 1% for 80% total workshop Critical Chance.

content: Critical Factor Workshop Stat. Definition. Critical Factor is the damage multiplier used when a critical hit lands. It also feeds Ultimate Weapon critical-hit behavior when Ultimate Crit is active. Type: Workshop. Category: Attack. Aliases: cf. Formula. None. Workshop. Unlocked at the start of the game. 150 workshop levels. Base multiplier 1.2; each level adds 0.1 for 16.2 total.

Category: Attack. Formula. None. Workshop. Unlocked after Critical Factor. 79 workshop levels. Starts at 30m; each level adds 0.5m for 69.5m total.

content: Damage / Meter Workshop Stat. Definition. Damage / Meter increases damage based on the enemy's distance from the tower. It applies per whole meter of distance and does not increase fractionally between meters. Type: Workshop. Category: Attack. Aliases: dpm. Formula. Damage × DPM% × range Enhancement support and other damage multipliers still affect the final damage context. Workshop. Unlocked with Range. 200 workshop levels. Starts at 0% and ramps to 5.9% total.

title: Health Workshop Stat
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Health Workshop Stat mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about the Health Enhancement row, unrelated Defense stats, or tracker recommendations.
content: Health Workshop Stat. Definition. Health is the tower's maximum health pool. It is the base defensive stat that other survivability systems build on. Type: Workshop. Category: Defense. Aliases: hp. Formula. Approximate eHP = (Health + Defense Absolute) / (1 - Defense %) With Chrono Field reduction: eHP = (Health / (1 - Chrono Field Reduction %) + Defense Absolute) / (1 - Defense %) Workshop. Unlocked at the start of the game. 6000 workshop levels. Health is increased further by labs, cards, perks, packages, and enhancements.

title: Defense % Workshop Stat
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Defense % Workshop Stat mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about the Defense % Enhancement row, unrelated Defense stats, or tracker recommendations.
content: Defense % Workshop Stat. Definition. Defense % is the percent of incoming damage reduced before Defense Absolute is applied. Type: Workshop. Category: Defense. Aliases: def%. Formula. Damage taken = Incoming Damage × (1 - Defense %) Defense % is hard-capped at 98% even if additive sources exceed 100%. Workshop. Unlocked with Defense Absolute. 99 workshop levels. Each level adds 0.5% for 49.5% total workshop reduction.

title: Defense Absolute Workshop Stat
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Defense Absolute Workshop Stat mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about the Defense Absolute Enhancement row, unrelated Defense stats, or tracker recommendations.
content: Defense Absolute Workshop Stat. Definition. Defense Absolute is flat damage reduced from enemy attacks after Defense % is applied. Type: Workshop. Category: Defense. Aliases: dabs; defabs. Formula. Damage received = Incoming Damage × (1 - Defense %) - Defense Absolute Enemy heat-up can raise true incoming damage above the displayed enemy-attack value. Workshop. Unlocked with Defense %. 5000 workshop levels. Defense Absolute scales through labs, cards, relics, and enhancements.

content: Thorn Damage Workshop Stat. Definition. Thorn Damage deals a percent of the enemy's max health when that enemy hits the tower. It also applies to ranged attackers and deals half damage to bosses. Type: Workshop. Category: Defense. Formula. None. Workshop. Unlocked after Defense % and Defense Absolute. 99 workshop levels. Each level adds 1% for 99% total workshop thorns, or 49.5% to bosses.

They instantly kill most enemies they touch, with important exceptions for bosses, elites, protectors, and heat rules. Type: Workshop. Category: Defense. Formula. None. Workshop. Unlocked by Orbs. 4 workshop levels. Each level adds one orb for 4 workshop orbs before other bonuses.

Starts at 20 seconds and decreases by 0.15 seconds per level to 14.00 seconds, with a hard cap of 7 seconds.

Type: Workshop. Category: Defense. Aliases: lmd. Formula. Land Mine Damage = Land Mine Damage % × Damage × (1 + Critical Factor × Critical Chance) × (1 + Super Crit Mult × Super Crit Chance × Crit Chance) Workshop. Unlocked by Land Mine. 200 workshop levels. Starts at 100%; each level adds 10% for 2100% total workshop damage.

content: Coins / Kill Bonus Workshop Stat. Definition. Coins / Kill Bonus is the workshop multiplier for coins earned from destroying enemies. Type: Workshop. Category: Utility. Aliases: cpk. Formula. Coins / Kill = (Workshop × Coins / Kill Lab + Module Effect) × (1 + Coin Bonus Enhancement) × (1 + All Coin Bonuses Perk Effect) × (Coin Trade-Off Perk Effect) Solve without rounding. Enhancement is effectively double-counted through both tier bonus and Coins / Kill context. Workshop. Unlocked with Coins / Wave after Cash Bonus and Cash / Wave. 149 workshop levels. Starts at 1.00× and increases by 0.01 per level for 2.49× total.

Aliases: ehls. Formula. Wave Skip can trigger additional skip checks for skipped waves. The source material treats these skips as deterministic patterns rather than true RNG at fixed percentages. Workshop. Unlocked by Enemy Level Skip. 699 workshop levels. Starts at 0.05%; each level adds 0.05% for 35.00% total chance.

title: Attack Enhancement Ladder
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Attack Enhancement Ladder mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about normal attack workshop upgrades, unrelated categories, or a recommendation about which enhancement to buy first.
content: Attack Enhancement Ladder. Attack Enhancements follow a spend ladder within their own category. The attack row on the workshop page lists Damage, Rend Armor, Critical Factor, Damage/Meter, Super Crit Multi, Attack Speed, and each new unlock requires more coins spent on earlier attack enhancements of the same type. Damage: Unlocked for free after Workshop Enhancements are researched. Starts at 1x and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a max of 400 levels for x5. Rend Armor: Requires 50 billion coins to be spent on damage enhancements to unlock. Applies a multiplier to Rend Max, chance, and Mult of x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus. Critical Factor: Requires 500 billion coins to be spent on enhancements to unlock. Increases Crit Factor by 1.0x when unlocked and increases by 0.1 per level. Has 400 levels for a maximum of x5. Damage/Meter: Requires 5 trillion coins to be spent on attack enhancements to unlock. Increases the Damage/Meter multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus. Super Crit Multi: Requires 50 Trillion coins to be spent on enhancements to unlock. Increases Super Crit Multi by x1.0 when unlocked and increases by 0.1 per level. Has a maximum of 400 levels for a x5 multiplier. Attack Speed: Requires 500 Trillion coins to be spent on enhancements to unlock. Increases Attack Speed by x1.0 when unlocked and increases by 0.01 per level. Has 75 levels for a max of 1.75x.

The defense row on the workshop page lists Health, Health Regen, Defense Absolute, Land Mine Damage, Wall Health, Orb Size, and each new unlock requires more coins spent on earlier defense enhancements of the same type. Health: Health enhancement is unlocked for free after completing the Workshop Enhancement Labs. Increases Health by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum of 400 levels for a multiplier of x5.00. Health Regen: Requires 50 billion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases the health regen multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus. Defense Absolute: Requires 500 billion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases the Defense Absolute multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus. Land Mine Damage: Requires 5 trillion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases Land Mine Damage multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.06x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 25x bonus. Wall Health: Requires 50 trillion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases Wall Health by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus. Orb Size: Requires 500 trillion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases Orb Size by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 200 for 3x orb size.

The utility row on the workshop page lists Cash Bonus, Coin Bonus, Cells/Kill Bonus, Free Upgrades, Packages, Enemy Level Skips, and each new unlock requires more coins spent on earlier utility enhancements of the same type. Cash Bonus: Cash Bonus enhancement is unlocked for free after completing the Workshop Enhancement Labs. Increases the Cash Bonus multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. The Cash workshop enhancement also increases the cash per wave, interest percentage, and max interest per wave amount by 1% each upgrade as well. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus. Coin Bonus: Requires 50 billion coins to be spent on Utility enhancements to unlock. Increases the Coin Bonus multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 200 for a 3x bonus. Note: Coin Bonus enhancement affects tier bonus and Coins/kill. This means the overall benefit of Coin Bonus enhancement is squared. Cells/Kill Bonus: Requires 500 billion coins to be spent on Utility enhancements to unlock. Increases Cells/Kill by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 200 for a 3x bonus. Free Upgrades: Requires 5 trillion coins to be spent on Utility enhancements to unlock. Increases all Free Upgrades by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 100 for a 2x bonus. Packages: Requires 50 trillion coins to be spent on Utility enhancements to unlock. Increases Max Recovery Package and Recovery Amount by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. title: Ultimate Weapons Overview
disambiguation: This entry is about the Ultimate Weapons system itself, not an individual weapon's stat table, a single UW+ ability, or unrelated workshop stats. This chunk describes the mechanic itself, not its interactions.
content: Ultimate Weapons Overview. This file reorganizes Ultimate Weapon knowledge into the same keyed mechanic format used by the Workshop source. The original raw source remains preserved in public/knowledge/ultimate_weapons for side-by-side comparison. Definition: Ultimate Weapons are workshop-owned systems purchased with Power Stones. Each unlocked Ultimate Weapon has three base upgrade stats, all owned Ultimate Weapons can run in the same round, and Ultimate Weapon Plus adds a second layer of upgrades after the full set is unlocked. Type: System. Category: Workshop. Aliases: uw. Costs: 1st through 9th weapon costs are 5, 50, 150, 300, 800, 1250, 1750, 2400, and 3000 stones for 9705 total. Usage: All owned and perk-granted Ultimate Weapons can run together in a round. They auto-activate when cooldown hits zero, and the cooldown resets immediately even if the previous activation is still active. Toggle limit: Turning a UW off and back on resets its cooldown, and UWs can only be toggled 40 times in a run. Formula: Ultimate Weapon Damage = UW Multiplier * Core Module Multiplier * Damage * (1 + Critical Factor * Critical Chance) * (1 + Super Crit Mult * Super Crit Chance * Critical Chance). Critical Ultimate Weapon Damage with Ultimate Crit = Ultimate Weapon Damage * Critical Factor. Workshop: Purchasing: Ultimate Weapons are bought with Power Stones. Each purchase shows 3 random remaining weapons with equal odds, and closing the menu without buying keeps the same offer. Enhancements: Ultimate Weapon Plus unlocks after all 9 base Ultimate Weapons are owned. Unlock costs increase by owned UW+ count: 500, 625, 750, 975, 1250, 1650, 2200, 2900, 3800. Each UW+ ability starts at level 0 and follows one of the documented cost trees. Labs: Each weapon has its own lab support listed on the weapon entry. Cards: Ultimate Crit can make damage-dealing Ultimate Weapons crit using workshop Critical Factor. It does not apply to % based damage. Modules: Core module substats directly modify named Ultimate Weapon stats and are listed on each weapon entry. Damage-dealing UWs also inherit shared Workshop-stat module boosts, so Cannon Critical Chance, Critical Factor, and Super Crit substats, plus other module effects that multiply tower damage, can raise UW damage through the shared formula. Unique modules: Multiverse Nexus synchronizes Death Wave, Golden Tower, and Black Hole and sets their shared cooldown to the average of the three with Epic +20s, Legendary +10s, Mythic +1s, and Ancestral -10s. Galaxy Compressor, a Generator unique module rather than a Core unique module, also affects cooldown-based UWs by reducing their cooldowns by 10s, 13s, 17s, and 20s on package pickup at Epic, Legendary, Mythic, and Ancestral. Some weapons also take direct support from other module families, such as Space Displacer feeding Inner Land Mines. Relics: Global relic bonus pool includes Ultimate Damage +35% total possible. Relic bonuses of the same type add together and multiply with other bonus families. Vault: Power Vault contains four separate 5% Ultimate Weapon Damage nodes for +20% total global UW damage. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon grants one currently unowned UW in a semi-upgraded form for the run, still takes applicable module substats, does not unlock labs, and leaves the perk pool once all UWs are owned. Weapon-specific UW perks only appear when that UW is unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk, and they are: 4 More Smart Missiles, Swamp Radius x1.5, +1 Wave on Death Wave, Extra Set of Inner Mines, Golden Tower Bonus x1.5, Chain Lightning Damage x2, Chrono Field Duration +5s, Black Hole Duration +12.0s, and Spotlight Damage Bonus x1.5. title: Ultimate Weapon Damage Formula
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Ultimate Weapons, Critical Factor, and Super Crit Chance, not the individual mechanics. It is not about purchase costs, toggle rules, or non-damaging Ultimate Weapon effects.
content: Ultimate Weapon Damage Formula. Formula: Ultimate Weapon Damage = UW Multiplier * Core Module Multiplier * Damage * (1 + Critical Factor * Critical Chance) * (1 + Super Crit Mult * Super Crit Chance * Critical Chance). Critical Ultimate Weapon Damage with Ultimate Crit = Ultimate Weapon Damage * Critical Factor. Cards: Ultimate Crit can make damage-dealing Ultimate Weapons crit using workshop Critical Factor. It does not apply to % based damage. Modules: Core module substats directly modify named Ultimate Weapon stats and are listed on each weapon entry. Damage-dealing UWs also inherit shared Workshop-stat module boosts, so Cannon Critical Chance, Critical Factor, and Super Crit substats, plus other module effects that multiply tower damage, can raise UW damage through the shared formula. Unique modules: Multiverse Nexus synchronizes Death Wave, Golden Tower, and Black Hole and sets their shared cooldown to the average of the three with Epic +20s, Legendary +10s, Mythic +1s, and Ancestral -10s. Galaxy Compressor, a Generator unique module rather than a Core unique module, also affects cooldown-based UWs by reducing their cooldowns by 10s, 13s, 17s, and 20s on package pickup at Epic, Legendary, Mythic, and Ancestral. Some weapons also take direct support from other module families, such as Space Displacer feeding Inner Land Mines. Relics: Global relic bonus pool includes Ultimate Damage +35% total possible. Relic bonuses of the same type add together and multiply with other bonus families. Vault: Power Vault contains four separate 5% Ultimate Weapon Damage nodes for +20% total global UW damage.
interaction_summary: Damage-dealing Ultimate Weapons multiply base damage by critical and super critical workshop factors.

title: Golden Tower and Golden Combo Interaction
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Golden Tower and Golden Combo, not the Golden Tower mechanic by itself. It is not a general optimization guide or a comparison against other Ultimate Weapons.
content: Golden Tower and Golden Combo Interaction. Golden Tower and Golden Combo Interaction. Golden Combo is the Golden Tower Ultimate Weapon Plus row and increases cash and coins earned after Golden Tower finishes by x% per kill. Formula: Bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^Kill) - 1 Golden Combo only counts kills from enemies that spawned during the current Golden Tower activation. Enemies alive before activation do not count. Behavior: Final bonus depends heavily on Golden Tower duration. K = kills during GT = kills per second * duration = Kps * d B = bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^K) - 1 I = income during GT = K * income per mob T = number of GT activations = total duration / GT CD Final income: T * I * (1 + B)
interaction_summary: Golden Combo scales Golden Tower post-activation income using kill count during the activation window.

title: Golden Tower Duration Interaction
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Golden Tower and its Duration stat, not Golden Tower in isolation. It is not a scenario comparison table or a strategy recommendation.
content: Golden Tower Duration Interaction. Golden Tower Duration Interaction. Golden Combo final bonus depends on Golden Tower duration because kills during the activation window scale with kills per second times duration. Behavior: Final bonus depends heavily on Golden Tower duration. K = kills during GT = kills per second * duration = Kps * d B = bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^K) - 1 I = income during GT = K * income per mob T = number of GT activations = total duration / GT CD Final income: T * I * (1 + B) 100% GT Uptime: If GT is already at 100% uptime (such as when using MVN or GC), the calculation changes a bit. T = Number of GT activations = Total duration / d FI = Final income =T * (I + I * B) => T * I * (1 + B) => Total duration * Kps * income per mob * ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^(Kps * d))
interaction_summary: Golden Tower duration changes both kills counted during the activation window and the final Golden Combo income result.

title: Golden Tower Cooldown Interaction
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Golden Tower and its Cooldown stat, not Golden Tower by itself. It is not a module tier comparison or a farming recommendation.
content: Golden Tower Cooldown Interaction. Golden Tower Cooldown Interaction. In the Golden Tower behavior rules, T is the number of activations and is defined from total duration divided by cooldown, so cooldown changes how often Golden Tower can generate activation-based income windows. Behavior: Final bonus depends heavily on Golden Tower duration. K = kills during GT = kills per second * duration = Kps * d B = bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^K) - 1 I = income during GT = K * income per mob T = number of GT activations = total duration / GT CD Final income: T * I * (1 + B) 100% GT Uptime: If GT is already at 100% uptime (such as when using MVN or GC), the calculation changes a bit. T = Number of GT activations = Total duration / d FI = Final income =T * (I + I * B) => T * I * (1 + B) => Total duration * Kps * income per mob * ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^(Kps * d))
interaction_summary: Golden Tower cooldown controls how often activations occur and therefore how the total income formula is evaluated over time.

title: Golden Tower Lab Interactions
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Golden Tower and its Golden Tower Bonus and Golden Tower Duration labs, not the Golden Tower mechanic by itself. It is not a lab priority guide.
content: Golden Tower Lab Interactions. Golden Tower Lab Interactions. Golden Tower interacts with Golden Tower Bonus and Golden Tower Duration. Golden Tower Bonus increases the base bonus stat, and Golden Tower Duration increases the base duration stat. Labs: Unlocks labs in Milestones at Tier 4 Wave 200, unlocking Golden Tower Bonus and Golden Tower Duration. Each lab increases the base level of its respective workshop stat. Golden Tower Bonus Has 25 levels, with each level increasing the Golden Tower bonus by 0.15, for a total additional bonus of 3.75. Golden Tower Duration Has 20 levels, each increasing the duration of Golden Tower, for a total duration increase of 20s.
interaction_summary: Golden Tower Bonus and Golden Tower Duration labs directly increase Golden Tower base values and therefore modify its income behavior.

title: Golden Tower Income Interactions
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Golden Tower and kill-based cash and coin income, not the Golden Tower mechanic by itself. It is not a comparative income table or a strategy chunk.
content: Golden Tower Income Interactions. Golden Tower Income Interactions. Golden Tower modifies Cash Income and Coin Income from enemy kills while it is active. Golden Combo then converts kills during the activation window into an additional post-activation multiplier on that Cash Income and Coin Income flow. Definition: Golden Tower turns the tower golden for a period of time after a cooldown. While active, it provides a multiplier to cash and coins earned from enemy kills. Golden Tower does not deal damage; it modifies income. Behavior: Final bonus depends heavily on Golden Tower duration. K = kills during GT = kills per second * duration = Kps * d B = bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^K) - 1 I = income during GT = K * income per mob T = number of GT activations = total duration / GT CD Final income: T * I * (1 + B)
interaction_summary: Golden Tower modifies kill-based cash and coin income during its active window and Golden Combo extends that income interaction after the window ends.

Legendary: 20%. Mythic: 25%. Ancestral: 30%.

title: Black Hole Lab Interactions
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Black Hole and its Black Hole Damage, Coin Bonus, Extra Black Hole, and Disable Ranged Enemies labs, not the Black Hole mechanic by itself. It is not a lab priority guide.
content: Black Hole Lab Interactions. Black Hole Lab Interactions. Black Hole labs add a percent-health damage rider, extra coins, an extra hole, and ranged-enemy denial behavior. Formula: None for the base pull effect. Black Hole Damage lab uses % enemy health per second and is not the global tower-damage UW formula. Labs: Black Hole Damage and Black Hole Coin Bonus unlock at Tier 5 Wave 150. Extra Black Hole unlocks at Tier 5 Wave 500. Black Hole Disable Ranged Enemies unlocks at Tier 14 Wave 20. Black Hole Damage: Black Hole deals a percent of enemy total health per second. Protectors do not reduce damage from Black Hole. Has 10 levels. Black Hole Coin Bonus: Extra coins are earned by enemies killed within Black Hole. Enemies do not need to be killed by Black Hole to receive this bonus, nor do they need to be affected by its pull. Extra Black Hole: A second Black Hole spawns when Black Hole is active. The second Black Hole always spawns on the opposite side of the tower and has the same stats and abilities as the original Black Hole. Black Hole Disable Ranged Enemies: Ranged enemies inside Black Holes cannot fire even when in range. Unlocks at Tier 14 Wave 20.
interaction_summary: Black Hole labs extend the mechanic through percent-health damage, extra coin payout, extra holes, and ranged-enemy denial.

Mythic: 65%. Ancestral: 80%.
interaction_summary: Primordial Collapse adds an extra Black Hole and reduces damage from enemies inside a Black Hole.

topic: Black Hole Positioning and Sync Interactions

Galaxy Compressor also reduces Black Hole cooldown by 10s, 13s, 17s, and 20s on package pickup at Epic, Legendary, Mythic, and Ancestral. interaction_summary: Black Hole positioning depends on Tower Range, while Multiverse Nexus and Galaxy Compressor alter Black Hole cooldown timing.

interaction_summary: Light Range scales Spotlight bonus from Damage / Meter and is affected by Tower Range.

content: Spotlight Bonus Interactions. Spotlight Bonus Interactions. Spotlight multiplies damage taken for non-percent-health damage sources, and that bonus can be extended through the Spotlight Coin Bonus lab and the Spotlight Damage Bonus x1.5 perk. Behavior: Base stats: Bonus x8.0 to x43.0, Angle 30 to 90, Quantity 1 to 4. Spotlight multiplies all damage sources that are not based on % enemy health and are not based on wave stats. Labs: Spotlight Missiles unlocks at Tier 3 Wave 400. Spotlight Coin Bonus unlocks at Tier 7 Wave 80. Spotlight Missiles: The tower fires missiles from the tower after a period of time. Spotlight Missiles will not fire until the first level is unlocked and frequency becomes 19 seconds. Has 18 levels. Spotlight Coin Bonus: Provides a coin multiplier to enemies killed in Spotlight. Spotlight Damage Bonus x1.5 multiplies Spotlight's damage-taken bonus by 1.5x. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Spotlight is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run.

Ultimate Weapon Plus: Smite gives every Chain Lightning hit a chance equal to Chain Lightning Chance to do extra damage equal to a multiple of current wave HP. Smite activates up to 100 times per enemy. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked once all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased.
interaction_summary: Smite adds a current-wave-HP damage rider based on Chain Lightning chance and hit count limits.

title: Chain Lightning Shock Interactions
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Chain Lightning and its Shock-related labs, not the Chain Lightning mechanic by itself. It is not a lab priority guide.
content: Chain Lightning Shock Interactions. Chain Lightning Shock Interactions. Chain Lightning labs add Shock application, Shock Chance, Shock Multiplier, enemy damage reduction scaling, and extra consecutive-hit scatter damage. Labs: Chain Lightning Shock unlocks at Tier 7 Wave 60, then unlocks Shock Chance and Shock Multiplier. Later labs add enemy damage reduction scaling from Chain Lightning damage and extra consecutive-hit damage against scatters. Chain Lightning Shock: Chance to apply shock to enemies hit by Chain Lightning, causing enemies to receive more damage. Has 1 level. Chance starts at 2.50% and the multiplier starts at x1.10. Shock Chance: Chance Chain Lightning applies shock to enemies. Has 30 levels. Shock Multiplier: Extra damage enemies affected by shock receive. Has 14 levels. Enemy Damage Reduction Lab: Enemy damage is reduced by 10% for every 6% of health an enemy lost from Chain Lightning damage, up to a max percent. Has 30 levels increasing max reduction by 3% per level for a max reduction of 90%. Scatter Consecutive-Hit Lab: Increases Chain Lightning damage done to scatters by each consecutive hit as an additive bonus, so all values are effectively 1+ higher than shown compared with the original 1x first hit. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Chain Lightning for the run; module substats still apply, but Chain Lightning labs stay locked. Chain Lightning Damage x2 doubles Chain Lightning damage. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Chain Lightning is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run.
interaction_summary: Shock labs add a damage-taken debuff layer and follow-on scaling to Chain Lightning hits.

Epic: Chain Lightning shock can stack up to 5, and Chain Lightning has a 60% chance to hit the initial target. Legendary: stack cap 10. Mythic: stack cap 15. Ancestral: stack cap 20. Shock chance and multiplier are doubled.
interaction_summary: Dimension Core changes Chain Lightning target behavior and expands Shock stacking behavior.

title: Smart Missiles Missile Lab Interactions
disambiguation: This chunk describes the interaction between Smart Missiles and its lab upgrades, not the Smart Missiles mechanic by itself. It is not a lab priority guide.
content: Smart Missiles Missile Lab Interactions. Smart Missiles Missile Lab Interactions. Smart Missiles labs expand missile persistence, repeated-hit amplification, splash damage, explosion radius, and manually activated Missile Barrage behavior. Labs: Missile Despawn Time, Missile Amplifier, Missile Explosions, and Missile Radius are unlocked at Tier 7 Wave 30. Missile Barrage and Missile Barrage Quantity are unlocked at Tier 8 Wave 50. Recharge Missile Barrage is unlocked at Tier 14 Wave 60. Missile Despawn Time: Increases time until missiles disappear without hitting an enemy. Has 20 levels. Missile Amplifier: Each missile hit on a target amplifies the damage for the next missile on the same target as an additive bonus. Has 25 levels. Missile Explosions: Missiles deal area-of-effect damage, damaging surrounding enemies. Has 1 level and unlocks Missile Radius after completion. Starting radius is 0.30. Missile Radius: Unlocked after Missile Explosions. Increases the radius of missile explosions. Has 20 levels. Missile Barrage: Unlocks a manually activated once-per-run barrage of missiles with a base amount of 20 missiles. Has 1 level and unlocks Missile Barrage Quantity after completion. Missile Barrage Quantity: Increases missiles launched during Missile Barrage. Has 6 levels. Recharge Missile Barrage: Allows Missile Barrage to recharge after a number of waves. Has 7 levels. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Smart Missiles is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run.

content: Chain Lightning Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Chain Lightning gives tower hits a chance to spawn chain lightning strikes that deal a percentage of tower damage. The shown damage accounts for crit-based tower scaling. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Chain Damage. Aliases: cl. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Chain Lightning are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Chain Lightning allows the player to upgrade Damage, Quantity, and Chance using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Damage • Quantity • Chance Costs: Damage has 31 levels. Quantity has 4 levels. Chance has 15 levels. Total stones to max: 18,375. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Smite gives every Chain Lightning hit a chance equal to Chain Lightning Chance to do extra damage equal to a multiple of current wave HP. Smite activates up to 100 times per enemy. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked once all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased. Formula: Uses the global Ultimate Weapon damage formula with Chain Lightning Damage as the UW multiplier. Behavior: Base stats: Damage x2 to x7,961, Quantity 1 to 5, Chance 5.0% to 27.5%. Labs: Chain Lightning Shock unlocks at Tier 7 Wave 60, then unlocks Shock Chance and Shock Multiplier. Later labs add enemy damage reduction scaling from Chain Lightning damage and extra consecutive-hit damage against scatters. Chain Lightning Shock: Chance to apply shock to enemies hit by Chain Lightning, causing enemies to receive more damage. Has 1 level. Chance starts at 2.50% and the multiplier starts at x1.10. Shock Chance: Chance Chain Lightning applies shock to enemies. Has 30 levels. Shock Multiplier: Extra damage enemies affected by shock receive. Has 14 levels. Enemy Damage Reduction Lab: Enemy damage is reduced by 10% for every 6% of health an enemy lost from Chain Lightning damage, up to a max percent. Has 30 levels increasing max reduction by 3% per level for a max reduction of 90%. Scatter Consecutive-Hit Lab: Increases Chain Lightning damage done to scatters by each consecutive hit as an additive bonus, so all values are effectively 1+ higher than shown compared with the original 1x first hit. Cards: Ultimate Crit applies because Chain Lightning damage scales from tower damage rather than % enemy health. Modules: Core module substats: Damage Common +8x, Rare +15x, Epic +25x, Legendary +50x, Mythic +100x, Ancestral +250x. Quantity Epic +1, Legendary +2, Mythic +3, Ancestral +4. Chance Common +2%, Rare +4%, Epic +6%, Legendary +9%, Mythic +12%, Ancestral +15%. Unique modules: Dimension Core. Epic: Chain Lightning shock can stack up to 5, and Chain Lightning has a 60% chance to hit the initial target. Legendary: stack cap 10. Mythic: stack cap 15. Ancestral: stack cap 20. Shock chance and multiplier are doubled. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Chain Lightning for the run; module substats still apply, but Chain Lightning labs stay locked. Chain Lightning Damage x2 doubles Chain Lightning damage. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Chain Lightning is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run. Footguns: Dimension Core modifies Shock stacking behavior, not the base stone-upgrade stat ranges.

title: Death Wave Ultimate Weapon
disambiguation: This entry is about Death Wave as an individual Ultimate Weapon, not the Ultimate Weapons system as a whole, another weapon, or the Kill Wall UW+ row in isolation. This chunk describes the mechanic itself, not its interactions.
content: Death Wave Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Death Wave fires Effect Waves and then a persistent Death Wave driven by a damage pool. Effect Waves provide coin, health, cell, damage-amplification, and armor-stripping support before or alongside the damaging wave. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Persistent Wave Damage. Aliases: dw. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Death Wave are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Death Wave allows the player to upgrade Damage, Effect Wave Quantity, and Cooldown using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Damage • Effect Wave Quantity • Cooldown Costs: Damage has 30 levels. Effect Wave Quantity has 4 levels. Cooldown has 25 levels. Total stones to max: 29,391. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Kill Wall causes each Effect Wave hit to amplify the Death Wave damage store additively. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked once all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased. Formula: Uses the global Ultimate Weapon damage formula with Death Wave Damage as the UW multiplier, but the wave persists until its stored damage pool is spent. Behavior: Core mechanics: • The Death Wave is a single powerful wave that deals damage based on a damage pool. • The damage pool accumulates damage through multiple activations rather than resetting with each new use. • The damage pool only decreases by the exact amount required to destroy enemies, factoring in bonuses. • The Death Wave remains active within tower range until the damage pool is depleted. Effect Waves: • Before the Death Wave strikes, it is preceded by a series of Effect Waves. • Effect Wave Quantity is the stat formerly represented by Quantity and effectively functions like a duration because the animation is cosmetic while effects trigger immediately as waves are fired. • Effect Waves have infinite range and occur at 4-second intervals. Effect Wave utilities: • Coin Bonus: Enemies hit by an Effect Wave or the Death Wave drop additional coins upon destruction. • Health Bonus: Each enemy hit increases max health by 0.05% when destroyed. • Cell Bonus: Elite enemies struck yield additional cells. • Damage Amplification: Each Effect Wave hit increases the damage dealt by the Death Wave to that enemy. Starts at 5x at base. • Armor Stripping: Effect Waves strip armor from enemies, reducing their defenses against the Death Wave. Base stats: Damage x2 to x9,119, Effect Wave Quantity 1 to 5, Cooldown 300s to 50s. Labs: Death Wave labs unlock at Tier 3 Wave 250 and cover Health, Coins Bonus, Cell Bonus, Damage Amplifier, and Armor Stripping. Death Wave Health: Maximum health bonus from killing enemies marked or killed by Death Wave is increased, up to 12.5x base. Bonus health is tracked during a round by clicking on health in the workshop once at least one level is researched. Death Wave Coins Bonus: Extra coin bonus applied to enemies hit by Effect Waves or killed by Death Wave. Has 20 levels. Death Wave Cell Bonus: Extra cell bonus applied to enemies hit by Effect Waves or killed by Death Wave, up to 3x cell bonus. Has 20 levels. Death Wave Damage Amplifier: Each Effect Wave hit on a given enemy boosts the damage that enemy takes from the Death Wave, up to +50x per Effect Wave. Has 30 levels. Death Wave Armor Stripping: Each Effect Wave hit strips some amount of armor from an enemy, up to a max reduction of 10. Has 10 levels. Cards: Ultimate Crit applies to the damage-dealing Death Wave because it scales from tower damage rather than % enemy health. Modules: Core module substats: Damage Common +8x, Rare +15x, Epic +25x, Legendary +50x, Mythic +100x, Ancestral +250x. Cooldown Legendary -6s, Mythic -10s, Ancestral -13s. Unique modules: None dedicated to Death Wave in the Core family. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Death Wave for the run; module substats still apply, but Death Wave labs stay locked. The random-perk version keeps the base health bonus, coin bonus, and damage amplification, but not the Cell Bonus or Armor Stripping features. +1 Wave on Death Wave adds one more Effect Wave. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Death Wave is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run. Footguns: Current Core substat data modifies Damage and Cooldown only; Effect Wave Quantity is not currently exposed as a Core substat.

content: Chrono Field Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Chrono Field creates a timed field that slows enemies inside it. It is the only UW that can sustain permanent uptime because duration can exceed cooldown. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Enemy Slow Field. Aliases: cf. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Chrono Field are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Chrono Field allows the player to upgrade Duration, Slow, and Cooldown using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Duration • Slow • Cooldown Costs: Duration has 35 levels. Slow has 11 levels. Cooldown has 12 levels. Total stones to max: 9,946. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Chrono Loop causes enemies affected by Chrono Field to spiral around the tower based on a rotation rate. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked once all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased. Behavior: Base stats: Duration 5s to 40s, Speed Reduction 20% to 75%, Cooldown 180s to 60s. Chrono Field Speed Reduction is capped at 90% with substats. Chrono Field can sustain permanent uptime because duration can exceed cooldown by up to 10 seconds at the lowest cooldown. Chrono Field does not stack on itself. Any remaining duration from the previous activation is wasted when the next activation starts. Chrono Loop mechanics: Chrono Loop exerts a tangential force on enemies within Chrono Field range, causing them to spiral around the tower as they approach. The in-game rotation-rate value is the theta value, or radians traveled per 2 seconds. Labs: Chrono Field Duration, Damage Reduction, Reduction %, and Range unlock at Tier 7 Wave 90. Chrono Field Duration: Increases the duration of Chrono Field. Has 30 levels. Chrono Field Damage Reduction: Reduces damage taken by the tower while Chrono Field is active. Starts at 10%, has 1 level, unlocks Chrono Field Reduction % after completion, and applies after Defense Absolute is calculated. Chrono Field Reduction %: Increases the reduction of damage taken while Chrono Field is active. Has 30 levels. Chrono Field Range: Extends the range of Chrono Field beyond tower range. Has 20 levels. Modules: Core module substats: Duration current site data lists Legendary 43s, Mythic +7s, Ancestral +10s. Speed Reduction Epic +3%, Legendary +8%, Mythic +11%, Ancestral +15%. Cooldown Legendary -4s, Mythic -7s, Ancestral -10s. Unique modules: None dedicated to Chrono Field in the Core family. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Chrono Field for the run; module substats still apply, but Chrono Field labs stay locked. Chrono Field Duration +5s adds 5 seconds to Chrono Field duration. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Chrono Field is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run. Footguns: Chrono Field cannot stack on itself. Any remaining duration from the previous activation is wasted when the next activation starts.

title: Inner Land Mines Ultimate Weapon
disambiguation: This entry is about Inner Land Mines as an individual Ultimate Weapon, not the Ultimate Weapons system as a whole, another weapon, or the Charged Mine UW+ row in isolation. This chunk describes the mechanic itself, not its interactions.
content: Inner Land Mines Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Inner Land Mines spawns rotating mines around the tower that explode on contact for area damage based on tower damage. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Rotating Mine Damage. Aliases: ilm. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Inner Land Mines are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Inner Land Mines allows the player to upgrade Damage, Quantity, and Cooldown using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Damage • Quantity • Cooldown Costs: Damage has 30 levels. Quantity has 3 levels. Cooldown has 15 levels. Total stones to max: 13,522. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Charged Mine increases the damage of Inner Land Mines each second for as long as each mine remains alive. The charge does not reset until that mine detonates. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked once all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased. Formula: Uses the global Ultimate Weapon damage formula with Inner Land Mines Damage as the UW multiplier. Behavior: Base stats: Damage x10 to x3,021, Quantity 3 to 6, Cooldown 200s to 50s. Inner Land Mines cooldown is hard capped at 37 seconds. Charged Mine behavior: • Damage increases each second for as long as an Inner Land Mine remains alive. • The charge multiplier is applied to each mine individually. • When one mine detonates, the other active mines keep their current charge multiplier. • Charge on active mines does not reset when cooldown resets. Labs: Inner Mine Blast Radius, Inner Mine Rotation Speed, and Inner Mine Stun unlock at Tier 7 Wave 40. Inner Mine Blast Radius: Increases the area Inner Land Mines will damage when triggered. Has 20 levels. Inner Mine Rotation Speed: Increases the speed that mines rotate around the tower. Has 20 levels. Inner Mine Stun: When Inner Land Mines explode, they stun nearby enemies for 2.5 seconds. Has 1 level. Inner Land Mine - Chrono Jump: When an enemy is hit by an Inner Land Mine, the charge of the Inner Land Mine is boosted by this lab times the number of times that enemy has been hit by an Inner Land Mine. Has 10 levels and requires ILM+. Cards: Ultimate Crit applies because Inner Land Mines damage scales from tower damage. Modules: Core module substats: Damage Common +2x, Rare +5x, Epic +15x, Legendary +40x, Mythic +100x, Ancestral +150x. Quantity Legendary +1, Mythic +2, Ancestral +3. Cooldown Epic -5s, Legendary -8s, Mythic -10s, Ancestral -13s. Unique modules: Magnetic Hook. Epic: 1 Inner Land Mine fires at bosses entering tower range and 25% of elites get the same treatment. Legendary: 2 mines. Mythic: 3 mines. Ancestral: 4 mines. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Inner Land Mines for the run; module substats still apply, but Inner Land Mines labs stay locked. Extra Set of Inner Mines adds one more full mine set to each activation. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Inner Land Mines is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run. Footguns: Base ILM cooldown is hard-capped at 37s. Charged Mines keeps charge on undetonated mines even when cooldown resets.

title: Golden Tower Ultimate Weapon
disambiguation: This entry is about Golden Tower as an individual Ultimate Weapon, not the Ultimate Weapons system as a whole, another weapon, or the Golden Combo UW+ row in isolation. This chunk describes the mechanic itself, not its interactions.
content: Golden Tower Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Golden Tower turns the tower golden for a period of time after a cooldown. While active, it provides a multiplier to cash and coins earned from enemy kills. Golden Tower does not deal damage; it modifies income. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Cash & Coin Multiplier. Aliases: gt. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Golden Tower are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Golden Tower allows the player to upgrade Multiplier, Duration, and Cooldown using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Multiplier • Duration • Cooldown Costs: Multiplier has 20 levels, Duration has 38 levels, and Cooldown has 20 levels. Total stone cost is 27,186. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Golden Combo increases cash and coins earned after Golden Tower finishes by x% for each kill. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked when all 9 Ultimate Weapons are unlocked. Formula: Bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^Kill) - 1 Golden Combo only counts kills from enemies that spawned during the current Golden Tower activation. Enemies alive before activation do not count. Behavior: Final bonus depends heavily on Golden Tower duration. K = kills during GT = kills per second * duration = Kps * d B = bonus multiplier = ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^K) - 1 I = income during GT = K * income per mob T = number of GT activations = total duration / GT CD Final income: T * I * (1 + B) 100% GT Uptime: If GT is already at 100% uptime (such as when using MVN or GC), the calculation changes a bit. T = Number of GT activations = Total duration / d FI = Final income =T * (I + I * B) => T * I * (1 + B) => Total duration * Kps * income per mob * ((1 + 0.0003 x (Level + 1))^(Kps * d)) Labs: Unlocks labs in Milestones at Tier 4 Wave 200, unlocking Golden Tower Bonus and Golden Tower Duration. Each lab increases the base level of its respective workshop stat. Golden Tower Bonus Has 25 levels, with each level increasing the Golden Tower bonus by 0.15, for a total additional bonus of 3.75. Golden Tower Duration Has 20 levels, each increasing the duration of Golden Tower, for a total duration increase of 20s.

title: Poison Swamp Ultimate Weapon
disambiguation: This entry is about Poison Swamp as an individual Ultimate Weapon, not the Ultimate Weapons system as a whole, another weapon, or the Death Creep UW+ row in isolation. This chunk describes the mechanic itself, not its interactions.
content: Poison Swamp Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Poison Swamp creates a damaging swamp that deals damage every second for a duration. Enemies damaged by Poison Swamp gain the Poisoned tag until death and move 25% slower while inside a Poison Swamp. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Damage Over Time. Aliases: ps. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Poison Swamp are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Poison Swamp allows the player to upgrade Damage, Duration, and Cooldown using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Damage • Duration • Cooldown Costs: Damage has 30 levels. Duration has 14 levels. Cooldown has 15 levels. Total stone cost is 19,196. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Death Creep increases damage dealt by Poison Swamp for each tick by x% of Poison Swamp damage. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked when all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased. Formula: Uses the global Ultimate Weapon damage formula for the swamp's tower-damage-based ticks. Behavior: Base stats: Damage x10 to x3,021, Duration 30s to 100s, Cooldown 125s to 50s. Enemies can be stunned once per entry into a Poison Swamp and may be stunned again upon re-entry or by entering another Poison Swamp. Enemies receive damage from one Poison Swamp when entering overlapping Poison Swamps. Although undocumented in release notes, Poison Swamp appears to keep the previous PS+0 ramping behavior, increasing by 50% base damage every second before Death Creep scaling is layered on later ticks. Labs: Swamp Radius and Poison Swamp Stun unlock at Tier 7 Wave 50. Later labs add Swamp Stun Chance, Swamp Stun Time, Swamp Rend, and Swamp Rend - Additional Enemies. Cards: Ultimate Crit applies to the tower-damage-based Poison Swamp ticks, but not to any % based damage interaction. Modules: Core module substats: Damage Common +0.5x, Rare +0.8x, Epic +1.5x, Legendary +4x, Mythic +10x, Ancestral +20x. Duration Legendary +5s, Mythic +10s, Ancestral +13s. Chance Rare +3%, Epic +4%, Legendary +8%, Mythic +11%, Ancestral +15%. Unique modules: Harmony Conductor. Epic: poisoned enemies have a 15% chance to miss attacks, bosses use half chance. Legendary: 20%. Mythic: 25%. Ancestral: 30%. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Poison Swamp for the run; module substats still apply, but Poison Swamp labs stay locked. Swamp Radius x1.5 multiplies Poison Swamp radius by 1.5x. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Poison Swamp is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run. Footguns: The current Core substat table exposes Poison Swamp Chance instead of Cooldown for the third stat, so Core support does not line up one-to-one with the base stone-upgrade row.

title: Black Hole Ultimate Weapon
disambiguation: This entry is about Black Hole as an individual Ultimate Weapon, not the Ultimate Weapons system as a whole, another weapon, or the Consume UW+ row in isolation. This chunk describes the mechanic itself, not its interactions.
content: Black Hole Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Black Hole creates a field that pulls enemies inward for a duration within a specified size. Labs can add damage, coins, extra holes, and ranged-enemy denial. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Enemy Control. Aliases: bh. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Black Hole are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Black Hole allows the player to upgrade Size, Duration, and Cooldown using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Size • Duration • Cooldown Costs: Size has 20 levels. Duration has 23 levels. Cooldown has 15 levels. Total stone cost is 9,723. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Consume causes each Black Hole to deal a multiple of current wave HP to every enemy affected at the end of its activation. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked when all 9 Ultimate Weapons are purchased. Formula: None for the base pull effect. Black Hole Damage lab uses % enemy health per second and is not the global tower-damage UW formula. Behavior: Base stats: Size 30m to 70m, Duration 15s to 38s, Cooldown 200s to 50s. Undocumented, unlocking Consume also increases the speed of the pull from Black Hole toward the center. Labs: Black Hole Damage and Black Hole Coin Bonus unlock at Tier 5 Wave 150. Extra Black Hole unlocks at Tier 5 Wave 500. Black Hole Disable Ranged Enemies unlocks at Tier 14 Wave 20. Black Hole Damage: Black Hole deals a percent of enemy total health per second. Protectors do not reduce damage from Black Hole. Has 10 levels. Black Hole Coin Bonus: Extra coins are earned by enemies killed within Black Hole. Enemies do not need to be killed by Black Hole to receive this bonus, nor do they need to be affected by its pull. Extra Black Hole: A second Black Hole spawns when Black Hole is active. The second Black Hole always spawns on the opposite side of the tower and has the same stats and abilities as the original Black Hole. Black Hole Disable Ranged Enemies: Ranged enemies inside Black Holes cannot fire even when in range. Unlocks at Tier 14 Wave 20. Cards: Ultimate Crit does not apply to Black Hole's % based damage lab ticks. Modules: Core module substats: Size Common +2m, Rare +4m, Epic +6m, Legendary +8m, Mythic +10m, Ancestral +12m. Duration Legendary +2s, Mythic +3s, Ancestral +4s. Cooldown Legendary -2s, Mythic -3s, Ancestral -4s. Unique modules: Primordial Collapse. Epic: spawns one extra Black Hole and reduces damage from enemies within a Black Hole by 50%. Legendary: 55%. Mythic: 65%. Ancestral: 80%. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Black Hole for the run; module substats still apply, but Black Hole labs stay locked. Black Hole Duration +12.0s adds 12 seconds to Black Hole duration. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Black Hole is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run.

content: Spotlight Ultimate Weapon. Definition: Spotlight creates rotating light cones that increase damage taken by enemies inside the beam. It multiplies non-%-health damage sources rather than acting as its own damage hit. Type: Ultimate Weapon. Domain: Workshop. Section: Ultimate Weapons. Category: Damage Amplifier. Aliases: sl. Basic Upgrades: Basic upgrades for Spotlight are located in the Ultimate Weapon menu after unlocking the Ultimate Weapon. Unlocking Spotlight allows the player to upgrade Bonus, Angle, and Quantity using stones. Upgradeable stats: • Bonus • Angle • Quantity Costs: Bonus has 25 levels. Angle has 60 levels. Quantity has 3 levels. Total stone cost is 42,236. Ultimate Weapon Plus: Light Range boosts Spotlight damage bonus. Ultimate Weapon Plus abilities can only be unlocked when all 9 Ultimate Weapons have been purchased. Formula: None. Spotlight is a damage-taken multiplier, not a standalone direct-damage formula. Behavior: Base stats: Bonus x8.0 to x43.0, Angle 30 to 90, Quantity 1 to 4. Spotlight multiplies all damage sources that are not based on % enemy health and are not based on wave stats. Labs: Spotlight Missiles unlocks at Tier 3 Wave 400. Spotlight Coin Bonus unlocks at Tier 7 Wave 80. Spotlight Missiles: The tower fires missiles from the tower after a period of time. Spotlight Missiles will not fire until the first level is unlocked and frequency becomes 19 seconds. Has 18 levels. Spotlight Coin Bonus: Provides a coin multiplier to enemies killed in Spotlight. They do not need to be killed by Spotlight. Modules: Core module substats: Bonus Common +1.2x, Rare +2.5x, Epic +3.5x, Legendary +10x, Mythic +15x, Ancestral +20x. Angle Epic +3 degrees, Legendary +6 degrees, Mythic +11 degrees, Ancestral +15 degrees. Unique modules: Om Chip. Epic: Spotlight rotates to focus bosses and reflected light increases nearby-enemy damage taken by x2. Legendary: x4. Mythic: x7. Ancestral: x15. Perks: Unlock a Random Ultimate Weapon can grant a semi-upgraded Spotlight for the run; module substats still apply, but Spotlight labs stay locked. Spotlight Damage Bonus x1.5 multiplies Spotlight's damage-taken bonus by 1.5x. The weapon-specific perk only appears when Spotlight is already unlocked or was granted by the random-UW perk that run. Footguns: Current Core substat data modifies Bonus and Angle only; Quantity is not currently exposed as a Core substat.

title: Bots Overview
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Bots mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about individual bot stat tables, shorthand aliases alone, or tracker implementation details.
content: Bots Overview. This file reorganizes bot knowledge into the same keyed mechanic format used by other deterministic knowledge sources. The original raw source remains preserved in public/knowledge/bots for side-by-side comparison. Definition: Bots are medal-based upgrades purchased in the Event Shop. Once unlocked, bot ownership and medal upgrades persist across events rather than resetting each event. Type: System. Domain: Event Shop. Section: Bots. Category: Medal Progression. Aliases: Players commonly use shorthand names for bots in questions and guides. GB and CB both refer to Golden Bot, which many players also call Coin Bot. AB refers to Amplify Bot. TB refers to Thunder Bot. FB refers to Flame Bot.. Behavior: Bots can only be purchased with medals in the Event Shop. Bots purchased do not reset each event. The shop offers 4 bots: Flame Bot, Thunder Bot, Golden Bot, and Amplify Bot. Bots can be turned off and on in the shop between rounds. Each bot has 4 medal-upgraded stats. Type: System Domain: Event Shop Section: Bots Category: Medal Progression Aliases: Players commonly use shorthand names for bots in questions and guides. GB and CB both refer to Golden Bot, which many players also call Coin Bot. AB refers to Amplify Bot. TB refers to Thunder Bot. FB refers to Flame Bot. Unlock Costs: Bot unlock costs depend on how many bots have already been purchased. 1st bot: 150 medals. 2nd bot: 300 medals. 3rd bot: 600 medals. 4th bot: 900 medals. Shared Upgrade Costs: All bot stat upgrades use the shared medal ladder shown in the raw source overview table. Level 1 costs 100 medals and each later level adds 40 medals. The shared table in the raw source lists costs through level 20, ending at 860 medals for level 20. Bot Respec: Bots and their spent medals can be refunded through a bot respec. Bot respec is available for 300 Gems once per event. Labs completed for bots are not refunded through a bot respec; only medal-related unlocks and upgrades are refunded.

content: Flame Bot. Definition: Flame Bot damages enemies in an area around the bot and applies a burn effect. Type: Bot. Domain: Event Shop. Section: Bots. Category: Area of Effect. Aliases: fb. Unlocking/Upgrading: Like all bots, Flame Bot is unlocked and upgraded in the Event Shop menu. The unlock cost depends on how many other bots have been bought. The raw source says each of Flame Bot's upgrade rows starts from the shared 100-medal base ladder and increases by 40 medals each level. Upgrade Stats: Damage Reduction Cooldown Damage Range Behavior: Flame Bot deals burn damage and does 1 tick of damage equal to bot damage per second. Damage Reduction starts at 20%. Cooldown starts at 75 seconds. Damage starts at x50 tower damage. Range starts at 30m. Damage Reduction reduces the amount of damage burned enemies deal. Cooldown is the time between activations. Damage increases the damage dealt when Flame Bot activates. Range increases the area the bot covers while active. Labs: Flame Bot Cooldown unlocks in Milestones at Tier 5 Wave 60 and reduces bot cooldown by 1 second per level. Has 25 levels for 25 seconds total reduction. Flame Bot - Burn Stack unlocks in Milestones at Tier 10 Wave 50 and allows successive hits on the same enemy to stack burn and increase burn tick frequency. Has 5 levels adding 1 stack each level, with a cap of 10 stacks of burn. Interactions: Flame Bot damage takes into account crit and super crit factor and chance. Flame Bot range is amplified by tower range. Type: Bot Domain: Event Shop Section: Bots Category: Area of Effect Aliases: fb

Stun and linger are 50% effective against Bosses and Elites. Duration starts at 5 seconds. Cooldown starts at 120 seconds. Linger starts at 20%. Range starts at 25m. Has 25 levels for 25 seconds total reduction. Thunder Bot Linger Time unlocks in Milestones at Tier 10 Wave 60 and increases linger duration by 0.5s per level. Has 20 levels for 13 seconds total linger duration. Interactions: Thunder Bot range is amplified by tower range. Thunder Bot stun and linger are only 50% effective against Bosses and Elites. Type: Bot Domain: Event Shop Section: Bots Category: Crowd Control Aliases: tb

title: Cards Overview
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Cards mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Cards Overview. This file reorganizes card knowledge into the same keyed mechanic format used by other deterministic knowledge sources. The original raw source remains preserved in public/knowledge/cards for side-by-side comparison. Definition: Cards are equipable gem purchases that grant effects while slotted. Type: System. Domain: Gems. Section: Cards. Category: Progression. Behavior: Cards cost 20 Gems per purchase. Cards grant their effect only while equipped. Cards have rarity buckets and are drawn from those buckets when purchased. Cards can be upgraded through duplicate copies up to max level 7.

title: Card Locking
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Locking mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Locking. Definition: Card Locking prevents equipped cards from being removed or swapped while the lock condition is active. Type: Rule. Domain: Cards. Section: Cards. Category: Loadout Rules. Aliases: locked cards. Behavior: Cards with the locked icon can never be removed during the run. When a Boss or Fleet Enemy is alive, all cards become locked until those enemies are gone. Presets can only be swapped during a run if the locked card set stays identical.

title: Card Slots
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Slots mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Slots. Definition: Card Slots determine how many cards can be equipped at once. Type: Capacity. Domain: Cards. Section: Cards. Category: Loadout Capacity. Aliases: card slots. Behavior: Gem purchases raise card slots up to 22. Harmony tech tree keys can raise total slots to 28. The total Gem cost to reach 22 purchased slots is 58,400 Gems.

title: Card Slot Costs
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Slot Costs mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Slot Costs. Definition: Card Slot Costs are the Gem costs for each additional card slot. Type: Cost Ladder. Domain: Gems. Section: Cards. Category: Loadout Capacity. Aliases: slot costs. Costs: Slot 1 is free. Slots 2 through 22 cost 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 750, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1600, 1800, 2500, 3500, 4500, 5500, 6500, 7500, 8500, and 10000 Gems.

title: Card Star Costs
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Star Costs mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Star Costs. Definition: Card Star Costs describe how many copies and Gems are needed to raise a card through its star ladder. Type: Copy Cost Ladder. Domain: Gems. Section: Cards. Category: Upgrade Costs. Aliases: star costs; copy costs. Costs: Unlocking a card costs 20 Gems for the first copy. 2-star needs 3 copies and 40 Gems. 3-star needs 5 copies and 100 Gems. 4-star needs 8 copies and 160 Gems. 5-star needs 12 copies and 240 Gems. 6-star needs 20 copies and 400 Gems. 7-star needs 32 copies and 640 Gems. Maxing one card takes 80 copies and 1600 Gems total. With 31 cards, maxing the full set costs 49,600 Gems.

title: Card Buying
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Buying mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Buying. Definition: Card Buying selects a rarity first and then a card within that rarity pool. Type: Draw System. Domain: Gems. Section: Cards. Category: Acquisition. Aliases: buy card; draw rates. Behavior: Base rarity chances are Common 80%, Rare 17%, and Epic 3%. Maxed cards are removed from the draw pool. If all Commons are maxed, Rare draw chance rises to 97%. If all cards are maxed, the buy card button can no longer be used. If the buy-card event mission is active after all cards are bought, it completes instantly.

title: Card Milestone Unlocks
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Milestone Unlocks mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Milestone Unlocks. Definition: Card Milestone Unlocks gate specific cards behind milestone requirements before they can enter the draw pool. Type: Unlock Rule. Domain: Milestones. Section: Cards. Category: Acquisition Gates. Aliases: milestone cards. Behavior: Recovery Package Chance unlocks at Tier 2 Wave 750. Land Mine Stun unlocks at Tier 7 Wave 250. Nuke unlocks at Tier 11 Wave 10. Ultimate Crit unlocks at Tier 14 Wave 50. Area of Effect unlocks at Tier 20 Wave 80. If every currently available card is maxed before another milestone card unlocks, card buying stalls until the next milestone gate is cleared. Death Ray does not have a lower draw rate than normal Epics and does not need a special unlock.

title: Card Mastery Unlock
disambiguation: This chunk is about the Card Mastery Unlock mechanic itself, not its interactions. It is not about unrelated cards, tracker implementation details, or other game systems.
content: Card Mastery Unlock. Definition: Card Mastery Unlock enables per-card mastery upgrades once late-game card progression conditions are met. Type: Progression Unlock. Domain: Cards. Section: Cards. Category: Masteries. Aliases: card mastery. Behavior: Card Mastery Unlock requires 30 cards maxed and the Tier 16 Wave 100 milestone. Each card mastery is unlocked individually on the cards page. A mastery only applies while its card is equipped. Unlocking a mastery costs stones and also unlocks that card's mastery labs.

topic: Card Locking with Bosses and Fleet Enemies
title: Card Locking with Bosses and Fleet Enemies
disambiguation: This chunk is about the interaction between Card Locking, Bosses, and Fleet Enemies, not the individual mechanics. It is not about slot costs, rarity odds, or unrelated enemy mechanics.
content: Card Locking with Bosses and Fleet Enemies. Card Locking becomes universal when Bosses or Fleet Enemies are alive. While Bosses or Fleet Enemies remain on the field, Card Locking prevents card swaps and removals. Once Bosses and Fleet Enemies are cleared, normal Card Locking rules revert to the locked-card set instead of the full-loadout lock.
interaction_summary: Bosses and Fleet Enemies force Card Locking until they are cleared.

topic: Card Mastery Unlock with Equipped Cards
title: Card Mastery Unlock with Equipped Cards
disambiguation: This chunk is about the interaction between Card Mastery Unlock and Equipped Cards, not the individual mechanics. It is not about card draw odds, slot purchases, or unrelated upgrade systems.
content: Card Mastery Unlock with Equipped Cards. Card Mastery Unlock enables per-card mastery progression, but the mastery effect still depends on Equipped Cards. A mastered card only contributes its mastery bonus when that card is one of the Equipped Cards for the run. This makes Equipped Cards the live gate for mastery effects even after Card Mastery Unlock has been achieved.
interaction_summary: A card mastery only applies when Card Mastery Unlock is available and the mastered card is one of the Equipped Cards.
